# Salih Maral — Digital Marketing Expert & Official Google Partner

Salih Maral is a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist and Official Google Partner with 17+ years of hands-on experience in Germany, Turkey, and Europe. Specializing in high-ROAS pay-per-click (PPC) advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google Gemini, Claude), Server-Side Tracking (sGTM, Meta CAPI), and Online Reputation Management. We operate on a transparent monthly flat-fee (Fixpreis) model without percentage-of-budget conflicts of interest. Serving clients in German, Turkish, and English.
